purpose: Minimal dark hero for legal documents

responsive.phone: Hero stacks tight with minimal bottom padding.
responsive.tablet: Bottom padding grows (tablet:pb-20); a decorative top-20 offset is introduced; heading steps to tablet:text-title-t.
responsive.desktop: Heading steps to desktop:text-title with desktop:text-body-l for the 'updated' date line; outer padding widens (desktop:px-40).
